backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining first-year MBBS subject data (Procedural Programming, Mathematics) with modules and content, exposing query functions to retrieve all subjects, subject by ID, and specific module by subject ID and name.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting deployment error investigation work, listing affected frontend files (App.tsx, DbInitGate.tsx, db.ts) and related components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files describing the attendance tracking app architecture, including data models, IndexedDB operations, domain logic, React hooks, UI components, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining color tokens for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, borders, charts, sidebar).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for MedAttend Pro PWA with meta tags, app icon, manifest link, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, description, display mode (standalone), theme colors, and icon configuration for MedAttend Pro.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping RouterProvider with DbInitGate for database initialization and logging app startup for deployment debugging.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main layout component applying dark mode based on settings and rendering page outlet with bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Class: Card component for a single class showing subject, type, time, topic, and attendance status with Present/Absent action buttons.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Conse: Groups consecutive class periods of the same subject/type into an expandable card showing total duration and individual period attendance controls.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six tabs (Dashboard, Add Class, Timetable, Records, Analytics, Settings) showing active state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/DbInitGate.tsx: Database initialization wrapper component with 15-second timeout, retry logic, and detailed error/loading states to handle IndexedDB connection issues during deployment.
frontend/src/components/MonthlySummaryCa: Dashboard card displaying current month's attendance statistics by counting individual class log occurrences (total conducted, attended, percentage).
frontend/src/components/NextClassCard.ts: Dashboard card computing and displaying the next upcoming class from timetable entries based on current day and time.
frontend/src/components/RecordDetailShee: Modal sheet component for viewing and editing individual class log details including topic, attendance status, and deletion with confirmation.
frontend/src/components/SubjectStatsCard: Displays attendance statistics for a subject split by Theory and Practical, showing percentages, classes attended/conducted, and calculated deficit or safe misses.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog form for creating or editing timetable entries with fields for day, time range, subject, type, and weekly repeat option.
Displays a weekly timetable grid organized by day (Monday-Saturday), showing scheduled classes with subject, type, and time, plus edit/delete buttons for each entry.
frontend/src/components/TodaySchedule.ts: Shows today's timetable entries grouped by consecutive classes, allowing users to mark attendance as Present or Absent for each scheduled class.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceRules.ts: Calculates attendance statistics per subject and category (Theory 75%, Practical 80% thresholds), computing attended/conducted counts and percentages from class logs.
frontend/src/domain/eligibilityMath.ts: Provides mathematical functions to calculate how many consecutive classes are needed to reach threshold or how many can be safely missed while staying above threshold.
frontend/src/domain/groupConsecutiveTime: Groups consecutive timetable entries with the same subject and type into single blocks, merging their start/end times and associated logs.
frontend/src/domain/statusColor.ts: Classifies attendance percentage into color-coded status (green/yellow/red) based on proximity to threshold, with corresponding labels (Safe/Borderline/Shortage).
frontend/src/domain/subjects.ts: Defines the three 1st year MBBS subjects (Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry) with their class types and maps each type to Theory or Practical attendance category.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor, switching between authenticated and anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functions, identity state management, and AuthClient integration for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalStore.ts: React hooks for managing class logs, timetable entries, and settings with IndexedDB persistence, providing CRUD operations and cross-component reactivity via event emitters.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with medical blue and white theme variables for both light and dark modes, including color tokens for UI components and charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AddClassPage.tsx: Form page for manually adding single or multiple consecutive class logs with subject, type, date, topic, and attendance mode (present/absent/partial). Saves logs to local store and navigates back to dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Displays attendance analytics including subject-wise comparison charts (theory vs practical) and monthly attendance trends over the last 6 months. Calculates statistics from individual class log occurrences.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard showing hero image, today's schedule, next class card, monthly summary, and attendance overview cards for Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry subjects with theory and practical stats.
frontend/src/pages/RecordsPage.tsx: Displays filterable list of all class logs with search by subject, type, topic, and date range. Allows viewing, editing, and deleting individual class records via detail sheet.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page for toggling dark mode, auto-mark present, auto-create from timetable, and exporting attendance data to CSV or PDF formats.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Manages weekly timetable entries with grid view, allowing users to add, edit, and delete scheduled class entries via dialog interface.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Defines TanStack Router configuration with routes for dashboard, add class, timetable, records, analytics, and settings pages, all wrapped in AppLayout.
frontend/src/storage/db.ts: IndexedDB wrapper that manages database initialization, version upgrades, and three object stores (classLogs, timetable, settings) with robust handling for blocked/concurrent access scenarios and migration from v1 to v2 schema.
frontend/src/storage/models.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the application's core data models including ClassLog, TimetableEntry, Settings, and AttendanceStats with support for medical subjects (Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry) and various class types.
frontend/src/utils/exportCsv.ts: Utility function that exports class attendance logs to CSV format with columns for date, subject, type, topic, attendance status, time, and source.
frontend/src/utils/exportPdf.ts: Generates a printable HTML document with attendance statistics table that opens in a new window and triggers the browser's print dialog for PDF export.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme tokens for UI components (sidebar, card, chart), and animation utilities for accordion components.
project_state.json: Project metadata indicating this is a fix request to investigate and resolve a deployment error from a previous deployment attempt.
